_comment: Written by `python3 harness/readset.py record`. Per test node: `files` = repo paths OPENED for reading or imported while that node ran; `scans` = repo directories LISTED. Read by `harness/readset.py blast`, which maps a working-tree diff onto the nodes it can redden. The two sets are not redundant: an ADDED file cannot appear in any read set, and its directory's scan set is the only recorded evidence that some node would have read it.
